hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Sort the array initially so the median element is positioned at index n // 2.

hints.title: Median Enforcement
hints.text: The median element must be adjusted to k. Any element before the median that exceeds k must be decreased to k to maintain sorted order.

hints.title: Right Side Adjustment
hints.text: Similarly, any element after the median that is strictly less than k must be increased to k.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting followed by a linear scan to accumulate operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Modifying elements without sorting fails to preserve the definition of median.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that only elements violating the sorted monotonic invariant relative to k need adjustment.
